CITY OF HOLYOKE

On March 29, 2025 Governor Maura Healey signed into law bodies to H.62, as amended by
S.2506 (which contains the final form of the bill), entitled "An act Relative to Extending Certain
Covid-19 Measures Adopted during the State of Emergency" ("ACT). Of interest to all
governmental public bodies in Massachusetts, the Act extends until June, 2027, the authority
for meetings of multiple-member bodies to be held in an entirely remote or hybrid format. All
public bodies may hold fully remote or hybrid meetings, without the physical presence of a
quorum of the public body, as long as "adequate, alternative means" of public access is also
provided.
Members of the public can access the meeting here:
https://hps-holyoke-ma-us.zoom.us/j/85287777627
Or by phone by calling (301) 715-8592 and then providing Meeting ID Web 852 8777 7627. No
passcode is required.

ORDERED by Ms. Lefebvre: That the Policy and Governance Subcommittee review the current
practices governing School Committee subcommittees and develop a policy establishing
consistent expectations for the organization and operation of all School Committee
subcommittees.
The proposed policy should include, but not be limited to:
The responsibilities of the Subcommittee Chair, in consultation with the Superintendent,
regarding agenda development;
Procedures for the preparation, posting, and distribution of subcommittee agendas and
supporting materials;
A recommended order of business for subcommittee meetings;
Expectations regarding the participation of School Committee members who are not appointed
members of the subcommittee;
The role and participation of the Superintendent, district administration, legal counsel, and
invited guests during subcommittee meetings; and
Any additional provisions necessary to promote consistency, transparency, efficiency, and
effective governance across all School Committee subcommittees.
